mapper.sql: ID as id, APPLICATION_NAME as applicationName, HANDLER_NAME as handlerName, DESCRIPTION as description, STATUS as status, INSTANCE_ID as instanceId, LAST_HEARTBEAT_TIME as lastHeartbeatTime, CREATED_TIME as createdTime, MODIFY_TIME as modifyTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_SCHEDULER_HANDLER ( ID, APPLICATION_NAME, HANDLER_NAME, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, INSTANCE_ID, LAST_HEARTBEAT_TIME, CREATED_TIME, MODIFY_TIME ) VALUES ( #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{applicationName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{handlerName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ONLINE', #{instanceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DESCRIPTION = VALUES(DESCRIPTION), STATUS = 'ONLINE', INSTANCE_ID = VALUES(INSTANCE_ID), LAST_HEARTBEAT_TIME = NOW(), MODIFY_TIME = NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM PEACH_SCHEDULER_HANDLER WHERE STATUS = 'ONLINE' ORDER BY APPLICATION_NAME, HANDLER_NAME
mapper.update: UPDATE PEACH_SCHEDULER_HANDLER SET STATUS = 'OFFLINE', MODIFY_TIME = NOW() WHERE STATUS = 'ONLINE' AND LAST_HEARTBEAT_TIME < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{seconds,jdbcType=INTEGER} SECOND)
